question: ATP Finals week trivia: at the very first year-end Masters in Tokyo in 1970, Stan Smith and Rod Laver both finished 4-1. How was the title decided?
question_short: 1970's first ATP year-end finals: Smith and Laver both went 4-1. How was the champion decided?
answer_detail: Tokyo 1970 was round robin only. Smith had beaten Laver 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 earlier in the week, and that result handed him the title and the $15,000 first prize.
answer_short: Round robin only: Smith had beaten Laver 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 that week, so he won.
